description: team-dash-matrix 의 룰 미사용 판. 값 동일, 쿼리·하드코딩 양이 다르다.

panels.description: 레코딩 룰 미참조 판 — 계산은 인라인 PromQL, 메타데이터·계획값은 패널 JS 하드코딩. 값은 team-dash-matrix 와 동일해야 한다. 원본 배분표 값(Spark/Trino/Pod/보장)은 출처 메트릭이 없어 JS 상수다.

targets.expr:
max by (cluster,queue) (
label_replace(
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore", state="guaranteed",
                          queue!~"root.*"},
  "queue", "root.$1", "queue", "(.+)"
) / 1000
)

max by (cluster,queue) (
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore",
                          state="allocated", queue=~"root\\..+"} / 1000
)

max by (cluster,queue) (
label_replace(
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="memory", state="guaranteed",
                          queue!~"root.*"},
  "queue", "root.$1", "queue", "(.+)"
)
)

clamp_min(
  (max by (cluster,queue) (
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore",
                          state="allocated", queue=~"root\\..+"} / 1000
))
  - on (cluster,queue) group_left()
  (max by (cluster,queue) (
label_replace(
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore", state="guaranteed",
                          queue!~"root.*"},
  "queue", "root.$1", "queue", "(.+)"
) / 1000
)),
  0
)

max by (cluster,queue) (
label_replace(
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore", state="max",
                          queue!~"root.*"},
  "queue", "root.$1", "queue", "(.+)"
) / 1000
)

max by (cluster,queue) (
  yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", resource="vcore",
                          state="pending", queue=~"root\\..+"} / 1000
)
label_replace(max by (cluster) (yunikorn_queue_resource{cluster="$cluster", queue="root", resource="vcore", state="max"} / 1000), "queue", "root", "", "")

sum by (cluster,queue) (
  max by (bucket) (minio_cluster_usage_buckets_total_bytes{cluster="$cluster", bucket=~"ic-.*"})
  * on (bucket) group_left(queue) (
    label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(1),"cluster","$cluster","",""),"bucket","ic-platform","",""),"queue","root.platform","","")
    or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(1),"cluster","$cluster","",""),"bucket","ic-fdc","",""),"queue","root.fdc","","")
    or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(1),"cluster","$cluster","",""),"bucket","ic-lfdc","",""),"queue","root.fdc","","")
    or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(1),"cluster","$cluster","",""),"bucket","ic-tttm","",""),"queue","root.tttm","","")
    or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(1),"cluster","$cluster","",""),"bucket","ic-pluto","",""),"queue","root.pluto","","")
  )
)

label_replace(sum(max by (bucket) (minio_cluster_usage_buckets_total_bytes{cluster="$cluster", bucket=~"ic-bmc|ic-ees|ic-ias|ic-mes|ic-nfa|ic-pnt|ic-sep|ic-smartbig|ic-tas|ic-tidx|ic-tsv|ic-wfbm|ic-wt"})), "queue", "root.smartbig", "", "")
